item.title: 【Requests】[REQ AUD] - Blame - Claptone Extended Mix
item.description:
Hi everyone, I hope you're doing well. I was wondering if anyone has this Claptone single;

Bastille – Blame (Claptone Extended Mix) 06:11 MIN
https://www.beatport.com/es/track/blame/30066300

If anyone has this release and would be willing to share it, it would be a huge help and I would be very grateful.

Many thanks in advance for your time and generosity. I sincerely appreciate any help!
